book.title: Baluwa jhukutumbula jha Pauli kwa Akatecholonike

content: Kutama kwa kuhalalicha Chapanga

Bhahe, makalongo bhango, mukibholite kubhoke kwito chimupalwa kutama kwa kunhalalicha Chapanga. Chakaka yenio ndi chimitama. Na ngohe tumpembelekeya kwa liina lya Bhambo Yecho nnyendelela kuhenga ghaumbone.
Nhwalo umanya ghala malaghalikilo ghitumpekii, tukampekiye kwa uhotolo gwa Bhambo Yecho.
Chapanga apala mangota mme bhanyahinyahi na muileka kolwa ngongola.
Kila munalome amanye chapalwa kutama na nhwana mundo kwa unyahinyahi na ichima,
na chi kilanga ngita bhando bhange bhangammanya Chapanga.
Bhahe, mundo jhojhoha akoto kunnemuu jhonge amu angamponja jhe nnyake kupete lilobhe lende. Nhwalo Bhambo ndi jwahadabula bhando bhoha ngita chatulobholila na kunkelebhuya hake.
Nhwalo Chapanga atukemite jhe kuhenga ngongola, nambo tutame kwa unyahinyahi.
Yene mundo jhojhoha jwakana mabholo ghanga, ankana jhe mundo, nambo ankana Chapanga jwampekeya Uhuke gwake.
Kwa malobhe gha kupalana, tupala jhe kunnyandikila. Nhwalo mangota mabhene mmolitwe na Chapanga kupalana.
Nhwalo yenio ndi chimwatendela akalongo bhoha bhubhabhii kwenio ku Makedoniya jhoha. Nambo tumpembekeya hake nnyendelela kuhenga kuchocha peniya.
Ntamengane kwa kuhengwa, kila jhumo ahenga ilebhe yake jwenio, na ahenga lihengo kwa mabhoko ghake jwenio ngita chitunaghalikiye.
Kwa kuhenga yenio nanhobholeka na bhando bhangaumanya Kilichitu, na muhobhole jhe mundo jhojhoha nhwalo gwa ghala ghumipala.
Kuhika kwa Bhambo
Makalongo bhito, tupala umanye uchakaka kwa lilobhe lya bhala bhubhawile, nkoto kubhehe na ungolongondi ngita bhando bhange bhangabhehe na lihobholelo.
Twenga tujheketela Yecho akawile na kuyoka, tujheketela Chapanga chabhaleta pamonga na Yecho kwa jwenio bhala bhoha bhubhawile kongo bhannyeketile Yecho.
Ghanga ghutunnobholile ndi mabholo gha Bhambo, twenga bhitubhii ghome, bhituhighilike ade papala kuhika Bhambo, chakaka natwalongolela jhe bhala bhubhahwii njwe.

Nhwalo Bhambo jwenio nahuluka kuhumii kunane kwa Chapanga, abhii na nhwilo na lilobhe lya nhenga mahengo nkolongwa jwa Chapanga na lilobhe lya lipenenga lya Chapanga, na bhando bhubhawile kongo bhibhannyeketii Kilichitu nabhatumbula kuyoka.
Peniya twenga tubhii na ughome, bhituhighilike natutolwa pamonga nabho mu lihunde kukongana na Bhambo. Yene natutama na Bhambo machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Ngohe, mpepechane kwa malobhe ghanga.
